decision.salesChannel: Printify Pop-Up Store (Printify's own hosted storefront), shop name "Fine Print Mercantile"

criteria: no professional identity requirement beyond individual KYC
where meme/niche text-design buyers actually are

evidence.finding: Printify exposes a documented, authenticated REST API (developers.printify.com) for shops, artwork uploads, product/variant creation, and a two-step publish flow -- true headless automation, no browser scripting.

Redbubble has NO official API as of 2026; every automation route (browser extensions, Selenium/webdriver scraping, third-party tools like PodPilot/Flying Upload/MerchGhost) drives the web UI, not a supported contract -- fragile and ToS-risk-bearing, disqualifying it against the agent-automatable-pipeline criterion.
TeePublic likewise has no seller-facing API for bulk automation; its upload path is the same browser-driven third-party-tool category as Redbubble.

Printify's own Pop-Up Store is free to open (no monthly fee, no setup fee, no listing fee -- you only pay the per-order base cost), requires no separate marketplace seller account, and needs only a one-time Stripe verification (identity, not a business license or professional credential) to receive payouts. This is the single account-plus-identity-action the outcome asked for.

Etsy remains viable as a second channel later (Printify can push to a connected Etsy shop through the same API), but Etsy itself requires its own seller registration with legal name, address, and SSN/ITIN for Etsy Payments -- a second identity step on top of Printify's, so it is not the leanest path to the stated single-signup outcome. Etsy does NOT require an LLC/EIN/business license for a sole proprietor, so it stays a credible fallback/expansion channel, not the primary.

Printify's base costs and product range beat Printful's for margin-sensitive meme/niche SKUs (Printify multi-provider sourcing keeps Bella+Canvas 3001 base cost lower per PodVector's 2026 breakdown), while a common professional pattern is 'Printify to test, Printful to finish premium SKUs' -- irrelevant to a zero-upfront-cost constraint, so Printify wins outright at this stage.

Meme/niche text-design buyers concentrate on exactly the marketplaces already covered by this decision (Etsy searches like 'programmers meme', 'geek memes shirt' return live listing volume; TikTok/tech-meme volume cited at 59.7M posts) -- evergreen relatable-humor sub-niches (coding, cat, gym, teacher, plant-parent humor) outlast single-meme trend risk and are exactly what the corpus targets.

pricingResearch.payoutFee: Pop-Up Store checkout runs through Stripe: 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction; no separate Printify or Etsy listing fee in this channel.

limits: Retail prices are recommendations set against cited comparables, not measured live sales; no account was created and no price was tested against real buyer conversion. Etsy figures cited for context/fallback only -- Etsy is not the chosen primary channel.
